caption:
The way i like to make my Curd Rice 
this isn’t classic or traditional in any way but it is loaded with ingredients i enjoy together and ive taken out the ones i don’t love!! 

how do you make your curd rice? what do you eat with your curd rice?
my favorite is to serve it with some airfried chicken 65! 
share your favorite recipe with me and i will try it out :) 

Nutrition: 
C: 47 | F: 8 | P: 9
Calories: 290 per serve
Makes 2 full servings 

Ingredients 
cooked and cooled rice
dahi
milk, i use lactose free = happy tummy
salt, to taste
sesame oil 
mustard seeds 
hing
curry leaves 
green chillies
